title: Data Representation: Convert & Calculate
welcome_lead: Roll up your sleeves — let's convert numbers between bases.
meta_desc: GCSE Computer Science adventure on converting binary, denary and hex with worked examples.
final_note: You're now fluent across binary, denary and hex.

concepts.def: Most significant bit — the leftmost bit.
Least significant bit — the rightmost bit.
When a number exceeds the bits available to store it.
Two hex digits represent one byte.

walkthroughs.body_html: Split into nibbles: 1010 1100. Left nibble 1010 = 10 = A. Right nibble 1100 = 12 = C. So 1010 1100 = AC.
